_comment: The 2-step rung with the time-step loop unrolled at trace time (unroll_steps). Rolled, Enzyme's reverse step loop carries a shadow slot for every forward intermediate of a step as loop state (64,134 elements, 72.9 GiB, counted twice by XLA: the 145.6 GiB of job 3511683); straight-line code lets XLA schedule and free them, as at 1 step. Reactant's while_unroll_threshold does not do this: it never unrolled the forward loop and its post-Enzyme application on the reverse loops ran past 4 h 47 min (jobs 3516665, 3520928/9, 3530023/4). Primal reference from the rolled run 3511683: -5.3233 Sv.
